about_the_game:
As an early purchase bonus, you will receive early access to the "Iga Ninja's Katana" and the "Iga Ninja armor set" (4-piece set), along with early access to the "Four combat styles."

1. Four combat styles:
- Hayabusa-ryu for Katana
- Hayabusa-ryu for Naginata
- Nioh-ryu for Katana
- Aisu Kage-ryu for Katana
2. Iga Ninja's Katana
3. Iga Ninja armor set

Note:
- This bonus is the same as PlayStation®5 pre-order bonus.
- Will be included in purchases made by 1:00 a.m. (UTC) on April 2, 2025.

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages, or may not be appropriate for viewing at work: Frequent Violence or Gore, Partial Nudity, Sexual Content
